knowledge_gaps: Timestamp availability at host inference is unresolved. The diagnostic loader supplies only item tensors; repeated items prevent reliable timestamp recovery from item IDs. A position-only fallback would not reproduce temporal training.

Historical pairwise time gaps describe spacing within a history but cannot measure elapsed time since the latest interaction without an authorized prediction-time reference. The stale-interest motivation therefore exceeds the mechanism's demonstrated capabilities.
Reproduction requires exact timestamp units, bucket boundaries, missing and malformed timestamp handling, padding masks, and event alignment through sampling and truncation.

The report replaces the original lexical-negative proposal without specifying a budgeted comparison against the corrected baseline and uniform-only multi-negative control. Validation frequency, checkpoint selection, and repeated-selection limitations remain unspecified.
Originality 3 is reasonable for an established HSTU mechanism. Potential 8 and difficulty 5 are provisional: no validation improvement or usable inference timestamp interface has been established.
